clinical.citation: Wang et al. 2020 - Large-scale targeted sequencing identifies risk genes for neurodevelopmental disorders (PMID: 33004838)

variants.description: Not specified; de novo missense variants (dnMIS) enriched in H2AC6 in the NDD cohort. No individual variant notations provided in the available text.
phenotypes: Neurodevelopmental disorder (NDD)/autism cohort; no per-patient phenotypes reported

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Statistical excess of de novo missense mutations in H2AC6 (dnMIS q = 0.053, FDR 5%) in a large NDD trio cohort; gene was also selected as a CNV candidate. No per-patient clinical evaluation was provided.

biological.citation: Tribulus terrestris L. protects glomerular endothelial cells via the miR155-H2AC6 interaction network in hypertensive renal injury (PMID: 34926670)
biological.summary: In an AngII-induced hypertensive renal injury model in glomerular endothelial cells, integrated miRNA/mRNA profiling and qRT-PCR showed that miR-155-5p expression was negatively correlated with H2AC6. TrT treatment raised miR-155-5p, which negatively regulates H2AC6 expression, so H2AC6 is proposed as a candidate therapeutic target.

biological.citation: Unveiling the Therapeutic Potential of Baicalin in Intervertebral Disc Degeneration: Integrative Bulk and Single-Cell Transcriptome Analysis with Experimental Validation of PANoptosis Inhibition (PMID: 40463856)
biological.summary: H2AC6 was one of five core PANoptosis-related genes (with FOS, CASP1, H1-2, BCL2L11) significantly upregulated in degenerated discs. This was validated in clinical samples, an IL-1β-induced NPC model and a rat puncture IVDD model. Baicalin downregulated H2AC6 at the mRNA and protein levels.
biological.significance: significantly upregulated (exact p-value not given in abstract)

biological.citation: Inhibition of lactylation by LRP1 expression increases the risk of intervertebral disc degeneration: A multi-omics summary-based Mendelian randomization analysis (PMID: 40988222)
biological.summary: In SMR analysis using eQTL and IVDD GWAS data, higher genetically predicted H2AC6 expression was positively associated with IVDD risk. H2AC6 is a lactylation-related gene. It did not remain among the final mQTL-eQTL-integrated genes (KAT5, CEACAM6, LRP1).

biological.citation: Global comparative transcriptomes uncover novel and population-specific gene expression in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (PMID: 37641095)
biological.summary: H2AC6 was identified as a novel differentially expressed gene in ESCC across populations. TCGA survival analysis marked it as one of three genes (with CHRM3 and CREG2) critical for ESCC survival, making it a potential diagnostic or prognostic biomarker.
biological.sample_size: six global populations (microarray datasets); TCGA for survival

biological.citation: Mitochondrial metabolism and succinylation-related gene signatures for predicting prognosis and drug resistance in colon adenocarcinoma (PMID: 42176930)
biological.summary: H2AC6 is one of two hub genes (with MC1R) in a prognostic model for COAD. It was an independent prognostic factor, and its expression pattern was consistent across single-cell sequencing and qRT-PCR. The model's gene set was enriched for protein heterodimerization and neutrophil extracellular trap formation.

biological.citation: Serum extracellular vesicle RNA profiles in long COVID: insights from exercise-induced gene modulation (PMID: 41588020)
biological.summary: After exercise training, H2AC6 transcript in serum extracellular vesicles was among the top 5 downregulated genes at peak exercise compared with rest in long COVID patients. The downregulated genes were linked to inflammation and metabolism.
